Microsoft Security Blog primary research post: SCKit worm, RelayTrap and RMM+ extension auth flaw (empty access key in 1.0.31/1.0.32) behind the ConnectWise ScreenConnect campaign reported Nov 11.
Unit 42 Cairn report: Chinese-speaking actor CL-STA-1238 ran 25 autonomous operations against at least 19 organizations Aug-Sep 2026, succeeding at 10.

SecQuill relays Huntback's 4EverAble2Shell finding (miners on 21 live N-central servers, 19 already on Hotfix 2). I read the SecQuill article directly: exploit repo at 03:58 UTC Nov 12, first decoy probe 08:30, weaponized SOAP request 09:16, so it is a report on a named researcher rather than unsourced chatter.

CVE-2026-90436.evidence: Huntback (relayed by SecQuill, article read in full) reports the 4EverAble2Shell exploit installed Monero miners on 21 live MSP N-central servers within hours of publication, 19 of which had applied 2026.4 Hotfix 2.

decisions.reason: Anchore SBOM guidance for CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder vendored as deps/brotli in Node.js); same vulnerability the main Node2Shell/HTTP2Shell story carries. Note the mechanical clustering put this event in the PHP2Shell story.

CVE-2026-111497.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-111497 to the KEV catalog on 2026-10-27 (Google Brotli unchecked return value), which the existing story already documents as active exploitation.

decisions.story_title: Oxio discloses breach via third-party account management vendor
decisions.reason: Read the MobileSyrup article in full: Oxio says an account management vendor serving it and several other telecoms was hacked on Oct 15 2026, exposing names, emails, usernames, addresses and account notes for current and former accounts; no passwords or financial data, internal networks unaffected.

decisions.story_title: CISA adds UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 to KEV after hot-patch to 6.2.7.1
decisions.reason: I confirmed the KEV entry directly in CISA's known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json (dateAdded 2026-11-13) and in CISA's Nov 13 alert, and the CVE record describes a labeled-response module flaw in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 through 6.2.7 that lets any user on a linked network inject server-to-server commands; UnrealIRCd shipped 6.2.7.1 as a hot-patch. Substantive enough for its own story, and no existing story covers it.

CVE-2026-114713.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-114713 to the KEV catalog on 2026-11-13 based on evidence of active exploitation (CISA alert of the same date).

decisions.story_title: PLANET GS-5220-8P2T2S stack overflow and IStaX cookie forgery patched
decisions.reason: CVE records read at cveawg: CVE-2026-109445 is an unauthenticated stack buffer overflow via an oversized webstax_auth cookie in GS-5220-8P2T2S firmware before 3.2412b261008 (CVSS 4.0 9.3 / 3.1 9.8) and CVE-2026-2336 is a Microchip IStaX cookie-secret forgery giving admin (IStaX before 2026.03). The post's fixed build is 3.2412b261022.
